title: Review Cycle Speed
scenario: Find games released within 30 days of each other by the same studio.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, release_year INT, release_month INT, release_day INT), developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT)
hint: Convert dates to a unified format or use MAKE_DATE().
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name, game_id, next_game_id FROM (SELECT d.studio_name, d.game_id, LEAD(d.game_id) OVER(PARTITION BY d.studio_name ORDER BY MAKE_DATE(g.release_year, g.release_month, g.release_day)) as next_game_id, LEAD(MAKE_DATE(g.release_year, g.release_month, g.release_day)) OVER(PARTITION BY d.studio_name ORDER BY MAKE_DATE(g.release_year, g.release_month, g.release_day)) - MAKE_DATE(g.release_year, g.release_month, g.release_day) as days_diff FROM developers d JOIN games g ON d.game_id = g.game_id) t WHERE days_diff <= 30;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT, release_month INT, release_day INT); CREATE TABLE developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT);
